(Ms. M. 1 <he>הקב״ה מקרקר אחריהם כתרנוגלין</he>; Ms. M. 2 <he>קִירְקר עליהם</he>; omitted in ed., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the Lord moans for them like a hen that cackles for her young; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 289">Yalk. Is. 289</cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 9:1">Ex. R. s. 9</cite> <he>התחיל</he> … <he>ומקרקר וכ׳</he> Pharaoh began to laugh at them and crow at them like a cock.
